dct_description_sm: Satellite imagery of south-eastern Victoria Island around Cambridge Bay, Nunavut, will be used in association with arctic landscape pictures and their geographical coordinates in development of a model which will allow determination of vegetation and habitat types solely from satellite images. The processed optical data of the satellite imagery will be used as a model predictor, along with predictors developed from associated digital elevation models (e.g., slope, elevation, slope position, soil drainage models), and predictors developed from archived optical data such as spring snow bank persistence.
dct_title_s: SPOT5 panchromatic and multispectral satellite imagery of south-eastern Victoria Island
